product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.su: The TFT-equipped Philos 48 Color Plus is documented in an NB1015 specimen.
product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.hi: The Philos 48 was part of Olivetti’s 1994 business range expansion. Olivrea records a specimen from that year named 48 Color Plus.
product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.ar: The specimen and the range announcement document separate configurations. Olivrea lists its NB1015 with a 25 MHz 486SL. MCmicrocomputer reports a 75 MHz IntelDX4 for the announced Philos 48.
product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.ve: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.li: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-48-color-plus.sp: Olivrea, Olivetti Philos 48 Color Plus NB1015.
